2609.04971.title: BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference
2609.04971.paper_summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve superior problem-solving through extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation, but the resulting key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and creates severe memory bottlenecks, often exceeding GPU capacity for long reasoning traces. Existing KV cache compression methods rely on recent queries to estimate future token importance, implicitly assuming these serve as reliable proxies for future attention patterns. We demonstrate that this assumption fails in long-horizon reasoning: certain decoding steps generate Thought Revisiting Tokens (TRT) that re-attend to distant previous context, such as task-solving plans formulated early in the trace. Through systematic analysis, we discover that queries corresponding to the TRT cluster into a small number of similarity groups in the embedding space. Based on this insight, we propose BeaconKV, a training-free KV cache compression method that maintains beacon queries, compact representatives for each global query cluster, to anticipate which KV pairs will be revisited without storing the entire query history. Across four open-source LRMs and diverse reasoning benchmarks, BeaconKV generally outperforms existing compression methods, achieving up to $5.8\times$ memory reduction while nearly preserving full cache accuracy and improving throughput by over $4.3\times$.
2609.04971.paper_summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）透過擴展的思維鏈（CoT）生成實現了卓越的問題解決能力，但隨著序列長度的增加，所產生的鍵值（KV）快取線性增長，並造成嚴重的記憶體瓶頸，經常超出長推理痕跡的 GPU 容量。現有的 KV 快取壓縮方法依賴於最近的查詢來估計未來標記的重要性，隱含地假設這些查詢可以作為未來注意力模式的可靠代理。我們證明這一假設在長期推理中失效：某些解碼步驟生成思維重訪標記（TRT），重新關注遠距離的先前上下文，例如在推理痕跡早期制定的任務解決計劃。通過系統分析，我們發現與 TRT 相對應的查詢在嵌入空間中聚集成少數相似性群組。基於這一見解，我們提出了 BeaconKV，一種無需訓練的 KV 快取壓縮方法，保持信標查詢，即每個全局查詢群組的緊湊代表，以預測哪些 KV 配對將被重訪，而無需存儲整個查詢歷史。在四個開源 LRM 和多樣的推理基準上，BeaconKV 通常優於現有的壓縮方法，實現了高達 $5.8\times$ 的記憶體減少，同時幾乎保持了完整的快取準確性，並將吞吐量提高了超過 $4.3\times$。
